findings.summary: Connections policy UI is read-only and cannot bulk-select channels or set policies.
findings.details: The task requires admins to bulk-select joined channels and set explicit routing and delivery policies. The route now shows the policy card, but ChannelTable renders only static channel/routing/delivery text and ignores the selectable flag, while ChannelPolicyDialogSummary only displays capacity labels and an Apply button. There are no checkboxes or equivalent bulk-selection controls, and no UI controls for Direct/Classify/Capture-only routing, target Brain allowlists, or delivery mode. The focused web tests cover view-model labels/capacity, not the required interactive control-plane behavior, so this is a false green for the UI requirement.
